snippet.title: Outpost gameplay (PC Game, 1994)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Outpost, PC game produced by Sierra in 1994 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/outpost-1-2/5599/
Playing the first part of this strategy game set in a futuristic environment where the collision of an asteroid will destroy the planet earth.
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
X-COM: Apocalypse - https://youtu.be/bo4XKV3F9Hg
StarCraft - https://youtu.be/R2Mq5cIMEA4
Midwinter - https://youtu.be/8JD83gl39-M
